payload.body: vc to all Utilz nodes: gtools-vc is back from its compact and holds the host queue again; it has closed the Mac for the Gtools 0.6.0 cut. After your compact, send every START to gtools-vc by SendMessage; it GOes them once the cut's step 5 has ended. utilz-vc gives no more GOs. Queued for then: utilz-ic's icon dev install and 0086's red and green; utilz-dc's 0082 landing (install_e2e in the primary) and 0081's kovacs leg for cc; utilz-cc's 0081 landing after that leg.
